title: Czech Heritage Museum

services.name: Exhibit Archive
services.desc: Explore the timeless traditions of Czech culture with our featured exhibits. Discover the intricate craftsmanship of Czech kroj outfits, as well as the fascinating history behind the Magic Gambler-a unique piece dating back to 1880, where it was used to decide who would be buying the drinks! The kroj (Czech folk costume) is a beautiful and significant representation of Czech heritage, worn with pride during festivals, celebrations, and other important events. Each region in the Czech lands has its own distinct variations of the kroj, with specific colors, fabrics, and accessories symbolizing different aspects of local culture and history. services.desc: Former supermodel Paulina Porizkova starred in this quiet film as a very young woman. Porizkova was born in the Olomouc Region of Moravia Czech Republic in 1965. When travel bans lifted during the Prague Spring of 1968, her young parents took a motorcycle to Sweden and left Porzkova with her grandmother. Before her parents could return, the communists locked down the country again, separating the family. Three years later, her pregnant mother was arrested and jailed while attempting to secretly bring little Paulina out of the country and then was trapped there for years until relentless pressure from the Swedish press influenced their release.
